name: dumbbell one arm snatch (left)
description: A single-arm snatch that takes a dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one motion. This version uses the left arm.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip it with your left hand and hinge at the hips.
Drive up with your legs and hips.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead.
Lower the weight back to the floor with control.
